title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: PDN Connectivity Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDN connectivity initiated by UE.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to activate default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: Request Type
entities.description: IE indicating type of PDN connectivity request (e.g., emergency, handover).

entities.name: ESM Information Transfer Flag
entities.description: Flag indicating if ESM information transfer is required.

entities.name: APN
entities.description: Access Point Name identifying the PDN.

entities.name: PDN Type
entities.description: Type of PDN connection (e.g., IPv4, IPv6).

entities.name: T3489
entities.description: Timer for waiting for ESM information transfer.

entities.name: ESM information not received
entities.description: Condition when ESM information is not received before T3489 expiry.

entities.name: Emergency request type
entities.description: Condition when request type is emergency.

entities.name: Handover request type
entities.description: Condition when request type is handover.

entities.name: Reject with ESM cause
entities.description: Network behavior to reject PDN connectivity request with specific ESM cause.

entities.name: Resend ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Network behavior to resend activation request and continue procedure.

relations.description: PDN connectivity procedure includes sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains Request Type IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains ESM Information Transfer Flag IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains APN IE.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains PDN Type IE.
ESM information not received condition leads to rejection with ESM cause #53.
Emergency request type condition leads to resending activation request.
Handover request type with no existing PDN connection leads to rejection with ESM cause #54.
PDN connectivity procedure may include sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message contains ESM cause IE.
ESM information not received condition is guarded by timer T3489 expiry.
